senses.sense_definition: A person who professionally raises and reproduces animals or plants for specific traits.

examples.text: The professional <w>breeder</w> carefully selected the healthiest dogs to continue the bloodline.
Many plant <w>breeder</w> experts work to develop crops that are resistant to harsh weather conditions.

senses.sense_definition: A person who is capable of having children or is actively focused on raising their own children.

examples.text: In historical texts, the term was often used to describe a woman who was a frequent <w>breeder</w> of children.
The social expectation for every couple to become a <w>breeder</w> has changed significantly in modern times.

senses.sense_definition: A heterosexual person, often used as a derogatory or slang term by members of the LGBTQ+ community.

examples.text: The character in the novel felt offended when he was labeled a <w>breeder</w> by his peers.
Using the term <w>breeder</w> to describe a heterosexual person is considered offensive and derogatory in most social contexts.

traits.comment: Used as a derogatory term for heterosexuals.

senses.sense_definition: A nuclear reactor designed to produce more fissile material than it consumes during operation.

examples.text: The government invested heavily in the development of a new <w>breeder</w> reactor for energy production.
Scientists monitored the <w>breeder</w> closely to ensure the nuclear reaction remained stable and efficient.

senses.sense_definition: A complex pattern in cellular automata that grows quadratically by generating secondary and tertiary patterns.

examples.text: The programmer spent weeks trying to optimize the <w>breeder</w> pattern within the game of life simulation.
A stable <w>breeder</w> can eventually fill the entire grid with its self-replicating structures.

senses.sense_definition: A specific type of shallow, wide 40-gallon aquarium tank often used for keeping fish.

examples.text: I bought a 40-gallon <w>breeder</w> to provide more floor space for my bottom-dwelling catfish.
The wide dimensions of the <w>breeder</w> make it an ideal choice for setting up a planted aquarium.
